item.title: Max’s Taphouse to host 22nd Annual Belgian Beer Festival
item.description: The family-owned taphouse in Fells Point is hosting its 22nd Belgian Beer Festival, which is free to attend.

item.title: Irvine Nature Center welcomes new executive director CeCe Carter
item.description: CeCe Carter, a Baltimore County native with a decade of experience leading environmental nonprofits, has been appointed the new executive director of Irvine Nature Center in Owings Mills.

item.title: Top 5 Stories This Morning: Hampden Boutique Hotel; Amy Sherald’s Record-Breaking Exhibition; and more.
item.description: Last week, we shared news about a boutique hotel in Hampden, artist Amy Sherald's record-breaking exhibition at the Baltimore Museum of Art, and photos of Baltimoreans enjoying the snow and ice.

item.title: In Maryland redistricting, looking back to the future could be best for the Bay and its people
item.description: Reuniting the Eastern Shore, minus Cecil County, with Southern Maryland in a 1st congressional district is best for the Chesapeake Bay and its communities.

item.title: Climate action moves forward despite Trump’s policy rollbacks. Will it be enough?
item.description: The world is making progress against climate change even though the U.S. government has left the fight. But will what’s being done ever be enough to stop climate change’s worst predicted effect: making parts of the world uninhabitable?

item.title: Maryland launches $5M apprenticeship incentive program
item.description: Maryland has launched a $5 million program to incentivize small businesses and other employers to hire and train registered apprentices.

item.title: Maryland Congressional map favoring Democrats clears second-to-last House vote
item.description: The Maryland House of Delegates is advancing a bill to redraw Maryland’s Congressional map in favor of Democrats, but the bill is likely to sit in a draw if it reaches the Senate.

item.title: Is your ex a snake? The Maryland Zoo will name a pile of dung after them!
item.description: Thanks to the Maryland Zoo, everyone can have a Happy Valentine's Day -- even if you have a crappy ex -- with Dollars for Dung.
